purpose: Fold the human answers back into the PRD, producing PRD-v2.md.

inputContract.notes: Same script as prd_interview, second pass. stage must be the literal 'revise'.

outputContract.notes: file is the absolute PRD-v2.md path; written false means the agent did not produce it.

outputExample.prdV2Summary: 초대 링크 진입을 로그인 없이 처리하도록 F0-1을 확정하고…

handoff.via: PRD-v2.md is what the human reads before approving; approval produces the approved-prd/v1 JSON.
